dedupe_keys.name: data set from fischertechnik smart factory model at university of st gallen

description: Ronny Seiger at the University of St.Gallen publishes sensor and workflow-event logs from a Fischertechnik smart-factory demonstrator. Zenodo supplies JSON-formatted text logs and two executable BPMN process definitions free under CC BY 4.0. The observations cover three storage and three production instances controlled through Camunda. They can calibrate activity timing and observation-to-process mappings in discrete-event manufacturing simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this experiment. Coverage is a small physical demonstrator, not a full production plant or a representative failure history. Acquisition dates and clock synchronisation accuracy remain unknown in the deposit. The two process filenames represent different activities despite a repeated storage label in one description, so implementation details need checking. No log was downloaded, process executed or activity-recognition accuracy reproduced.
